from pydriller.repository_mining import RepositoryMining

print("=== ORIGINAL BEHAVIOR TESTS ===")

print("\n1. test_should_visit_descendent_order_with_filters")
print("   User wants: 1f99 -> 09f6 -> 6411 (chronological)")
print("   Current test has: from='1f99...', to='6411...', reversed_order=True")
lc = list(RepositoryMining('test-repos/small_repo',
                           from_commit='1f99848edadfffa903b8ba1286a935f1b92b2845',
                           to_commit='6411e3096dd2070438a17b225f44475136e54e3a',
                           reversed_order=True).traverse_commits())
print(f"   Result: {len(lc)} commits")
for i, c in enumerate(lc):
    print(f"     {i}: {c.hash}")

print("\n2. test_should_visit_descendent_order_with_filters_reversed") 
print("   User wants: 1f99 -> 09f6 -> 6411 (chronological)")  
print("   Current test has: from='6411...', to='1f99...', reversed_order=True")
lc = list(RepositoryMining('test-repos/small_repo',
                           from_commit='6411e3096dd2070438a17b225f44475136e54e3a',
                           to_commit='1f99848edadfffa903b8ba1286a935f1b92b2845',
                           reversed_order=True).traverse_commits())
print(f"   Result: {len(lc)} commits")
for i, c in enumerate(lc):
    print(f"     {i}: {c.hash}")

print("\n=== WHAT USERS WANT TO BE ABLE TO WRITE ===")
print("\nFor chronological order 1f99 -> 09f6 -> 6411:")
print("User SHOULD be able to write EITHER:")
print("  from='1f99...', to='6411...', reversed_order=False  # normal")
print("  from='1f99...', to='6411...', reversed_order=True   # with flag <- THIS IS THE ISSUE")

print("\nTesting what users WANT to work:")
lc = list(RepositoryMining('test-repos/small_repo',
                           from_commit='1f99848edadfffa903b8ba1286a935f1b92b2845',
                           to_commit='6411e3096dd2070438a17b225f44475136e54e3a',
                           reversed_order=True).traverse_commits())
print(f"Natural spec with reversed_order=True: {len(lc)} commits")
for i, c in enumerate(lc):
    print(f"  {i}: {c.hash}")
